# The refund is 250, above the limit of 100 for the contain tier. The case waits for a person of the approvers of the policy row. While it waits,
# nothing is written. The question and the case are in the status. After the answer approve, the saga runs: the credit, then the reply.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

deskinit
deskfakes
subst home/.desk/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env DESK_DIR=$WORK/desk

exec beehavereal item add desk shift-1 --title 'Morning shift' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run shift-1 desk --workflow desk/workflow.star &

waitstatus 'paused: [billing] The clerk proposes'
exec beehavereal status
stdout '^item-desk-2-r1\trunning\tpaused: \[billing\] The clerk proposes'
! exists writes.log
! exists mail.out

exec beehavereal answer desk-2 approve: within the agreed amount
wait
stdout 'item shift-1 finished'

grep -count=1 '^credit-' writes.log
grep 'We refund 250 EUR for BK-123456' mail.out
exec beehavereal status
stdout 'item-desk-2-r1\tdone'

-- body.txt --
The morning shift.
-- home/.desk/config --
DESK_API=http://desk.test
MAILDIR=@WORK@/home/.desk/mail
CHAT_SPOOL=@WORK@/home/.desk/chat
CHAT_API=http://chat.test
MASK_SALT=testsalt
-- home/.desk/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- home/.desk/mail/cur/keep --
-- home/.desk/chat/keep --
-- home/.desk/mail/new/m1 --
Message-Id: <m1@mail.test>
From: Ann Smith <ann@example.com>
Subject: Refund BK-123456

Thanks, Ann Smith. Please refund 250 for BK-123456.
-- resp/_bookings_BK-123456 --
{"ref":"BK-123456","status":"cancelled","paid":300,"currency":"EUR","date":"2026-12-01","customer_name":"Ann Smith","customer_email":"ann@example.com","refunded":0}
-- resp/_eligibility_refund --
{"eligible":true}
